summary: The committed implementation adds the focused public-docs status tests, README discoverability links, narrow docs fixes for stale CLI command mentions, and checks off the exact TODO item. Iteration 1 includes passing evidence for the required docs-status pytest run, the combined docs-drift/docs-status pytest run, and ruff over both touched test modules. Iteration 2 replayed the focused docs-status test against the pre-implementation base in a temporary archive copy, demonstrating the expected initial failures without switching branches.
